title: SORTENTSTABLE DXF OBJECTS writer allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated full-file ASCII/Binary AC1027 SORTENTSTABLE codec transaction control only; no source-producer or support claim.

implementation.path: Public DXF OBJECTS callback in a complete dxfRW::write operation
implementation.profile: NOD parent, model-space block owner, four entity/sort-handle pairs, and two EED values

assertions: Each injected allocation failure returns a failed write and preserves pre-existing destination bytes.
The caller DRW_SortEntsTable, including handles, owner, sort pairs, and EED values, is unchanged after failure.
Retry with the same writer and table succeeds and produces byte-identical output to the clean write.
Fresh typed libdxfrw readback reproduces the selected table fields and EED values for ASCII and Binary DXF.

validation.observed_allocation_counts: ASCII 19; Binary 18 in both normal and ASan executables

limitations: This generated profile establishes rollback, retry, byte equality, and same-library readback only.
SORTENTSTABLE source-owner and dependency closure, non-model/paper-space profiles, producer coverage, and native consumer behavior remain unqualified; strict support gates are unchanged.
DXF files are generated from scratch in a temporary directory and removed by the test; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
